card.name: Opening bracket before section cross-references
card.fires_on: An opening square bracket that follows a dosing or administration statement and begins a cross-reference such as "see Clinical Pharmacology (12." It also fires on a bracket that begins a bracketed value or note after a dose.

modes.label: Cross-reference bracket
modes.description: Bracket after a dosing instruction that opens a "see [section]" pointer.
modes.example: Advise patients to swallow the capsules whole with water<< [>>see Boxed Warning , Clinical Pharmacology

modes.label: Bracketed dose value
modes.description: Bracket after an amount that opens an alternative or explanatory value.

card.plain: It marks the point where a dosing sentence ends and a bracketed pointer to another label section begins.
